title: Senior Software Engineer – Technical Remediation and Enablement - Vice President
description:
The Vice President (VP) / Senior Software Engineer – Technical Remediation & Enablement Lead is a hands-on, code-level technical specialist responsible for driving the direct remediation of software vulnerabilities across enterprise application teams. This individual contributor / team-level technical lead works alongside application developers and contractor engineers to fix static code vulnerabilities (SAST), patch vulnerable software dependencies (SCA/third-party libraries), containerize workloads, and streamline local build/release pipelines to achieve same-day vulnerability hotfix and deployment capabilities.
This role combines active software engineering (writing/refactoring code and debugging pipelines) with technical enablement, guiding squad developers on how to adopt internal security and build tools, resolve tricky dependency conflicts, and package applications into modern containers for rapid, low-risk production releases.

Key Responsibilities & Core Duties
1. Hands-On Code Remediation & Dependency Patching
- Write, refactor, and review application code to directly remediate static code analysis (SAST) findings (e.g., SQL/command injection, cross-site scripting, insecure deserialization, improper error handling, weak cryptography).
- Resolve complex third-party library and framework upgrades (SCA/CVE remediation), managing transitive dependency conflicts, breaking API changes, and version incompatibilities across Java, Python, Go, .NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
- Implement targeted automated unit, integration, and regression tests to validate that code fixes and patched libraries do not introduce functional regressions.
2. Containerization & Same-Day Release Enablement
- Work directly in application repositories to write and optimize Dockerfiles, container manifests, and base image configurations (Docker, OCI, Kubernetes/OpenShift).
- Assist application squads in containerizing non-containerized legacy services, establishing minimal base images and automated base-image rebuild triggers for same-day OS/runtime patching.
- Help configure and fine-tune CI/CD build scripts and release pipelines to compress deployment cycle times and eliminate manual deployment steps for emergency hotfixes.
3. Application Plan Technical Validation
- Perform code-level reviews of proposed remediation plans from application teams, verifying whether proposed library version bumps or refactored logic effectively eliminate the root cause of the vulnerability.
- Identify technical prerequisites (e.g., test coverage gaps, build tool upgrades, compiler/runtime updates) needed before a team can successfully patch and release.
4. Contractor Squad Pairing & PR Review
- Act as a peer reviewer and technical guide for external contractor engineers assigned to assist with remediation work.
- Review contractor-submitted pull requests (PRs) for code cleanliness, security correctness, test coverage, and enterprise architectural standards.
- Facilitate smooth technical onboarding and repository access for contractor developers.
5. Internal Tooling Adoption & Developer Feedback
- Actively pilot, adopt, and demonstrate internal developer tools, IDE security plugins, automated PR bots (e.g., Dependabot/Renovate patterns), and local scanning utilities within engineering squads.
- Troubleshoot false positives, scanner configuration errors, and build pipeline failures; provide direct, actionable feedback to internal platform and tooling teams to improve developer experience.

Required Qualifications & Experience
Education & Experience Requirements
- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field.
- 10+ years of hands-on software development and engineering experience delivering enterprise web applications, microservices, or distributed backend systems.
- Proven track record of directly fixing static code vulnerabilities (SAST) and managing third-party dependency/package upgrades in production environments.
- Practical, hands-on experience containerizing applications and working with container orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).

Technical Proficiencies
- Core Programming Languages: Strong, hands-on development proficiency in at least one or two primary enterprise languages: Java (Spring Boot), Python, Go, C#/.NET, or TypeScript/Node.js.
- Static Code Analysis (SAST): Ability to analyze and fix scanner findings from tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Veracode, or Fortify.
- Dependency & Package Management: Practical experience with dependency resolution and build tools: Maven, Gradle, npm/yarn, NuGet, pip/Poetry, or Go modules, alongside SCA tools like Snyk, Black Duck, or JFrog Xray.
- Containers & Runtime: Hands-on experience creating production-grade Dockerfiles, managing multi-stage builds, patching container base images, and deploying to Kubernetes or OpenShift.
- CI/CD & Version Control: Proficient with Git, branching strategies (Gitflow/trunk-based), and pipeline configurations (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Tekton, GitLab CI, Harness).

Core Competencies & Working Style
Competency
Behavioral Expectation
Hands-On Craftsmanship
Loves writing code, debugging builds, untangling messy dependency trees, and seeing clean PRs merged to production.
Developer-to-Developer Empathy
Speaks the language of squad engineers, troubleshoots shoulder-to-shoulder, and offers practical solutions rather than abstract advice.
Pragmatic Problem Solver
Able to quickly find safe workarounds or code refactors when direct library upgrades introduce breaking API changes.
Clear Communication
Explains the "why" and "how" of security fixes clearly in PR comments, documentation, and pairing sessions.

Key Performance Indicators (Success Metrics)
- Direct Remediation Output: Number of validated PRs merged and critical/high vulnerabilities (SAST & SCA) successfully resolved across assigned services.
- Same-Day Hotfix Readiness: Number of application components successfully containerized and equipped with automated verification pipelines capable of same-day hotfix releases.
- Turnaround Time for Technical Reviews: Fast, reliable review turnaround for application remediation plans and contractor pull requests.
- Build & Release Optimization: Measurable reduction in build and deployment friction for patched releases within supported application squads.

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
- Master’s degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:

You will work across the application stack, developing SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 user experiences as well as backend solutions using ABAP, CDS Views, ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP), OData services, and modern SAP development frameworks.
The successful candidate will bring strong hands-on SAP engineering experience, an understanding of S/4HANA development principles, and the ability to troubleshoot complex functional and technical problems. You will collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and engineers in an agile product environment to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions.

SAP Fiori and User Experience Development
- Extend, configure, and customize standard SAP Fiori applications and Fiori Elements, including List Reports, Analytical List Pages, and Overview Pages.
- Develop custom SAP Fiori/SAPUI5 applications using MVC architecture, JavaScript, XML, HTML5, and CSS.
- Configure and support SAP Fiori Launchpad functionality, including catalogs, roles, spaces, and pages.
- Design, develop, and optimize OData v2 and v4 services using SAP Gateway, CDS-based services, and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP).

title: Intermediate Backend Engineer , Security Factory
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in their code by contributing to the static analysis engine that finds them.

Your work spans both the engine and the tools we use to evaluate it. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities.

We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. You'll implement component specifications within the team's architecture, working with engineers and AI agents. Good judgment about when to trust agent output, and when to bring it to human review, is central to the role.

What you'll do

- Extend the program model, including parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis, to support new languages and frameworks.

- Build and apply AI-assisted tooling to implement, review, and validate engine changes and findings, in collaboration with the team's technical leadership. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.

- Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.

- Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.

- Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.

- Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, and identify and address technical debt that slows the team down.

- Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.

- Participate in on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.

What you'll bring

- Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to assess when their output is trustworthy.

- Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Rust or Go. Our engine is written in Rust, the analyzer wrapper in Go, and the monolith integration in Ruby. You'll be willing to work across them.

- An interest in static analysis and application security, including parsing, intermediate representations, taint and data-flow analysis, and how vulnerabilities arise in code. Deep expertise isn't required; we'll help you grow it.

- Organize and progress your work independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.

- The ability to communicate technical problems clearly and concisely and propose iterative solutions.

- Helpful but not required: experience with performance optimization, Docker and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), web or mobile frameworks, guardrails for agent-written code such as mutation testing and fuzzing, or program analysis and security research through publications or open source contributions. Willingness to learn performance optimization and containerized workflows is also welcome.

About the team

The Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab's SAST capabilities for customer software repositories. We work closely with the Code Security team on scanning rules and flows, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.

At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Flexible Paid Time Off 

- Team Member Resource Groups

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 
 
Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 
​​Within Microsoft Fabric, the Data Integration team enables organizations to connect, move, and shape data across their entire data estate. As data is generated across applications, devices, and systems, our integration capabilities make it easy to ingest, transform, and prepare data for downstream use. Fabric’s unified integration experience simplifies how customers bring data together, ensuring it is trusted, usable, and ready to power analytics, real-time insights, and AI scenarios. ​ 

​​The Azure Messaging team builds and operates the infrastructure behind Azure Event Hubs and Azure Service Bus, enabling customers around the world to stream events and reliably connect applications. 
We are looking for a Software Engineer to help make this platform easier to deploy, operate, and scale. You will develop software and automation for cluster provisioning, safe upgrades, fleet health, and capacity management. You will also improve the engineering systems our team uses every day - from deployment pipelines and automated validation to diagnostics and developer tooling. 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will own well-defined projects from implementation through testing and deployment. You will have opportunities to contribute to new region and cloud buildouts, evaluate emerging Azure infrastructure, and develop capabilities such as cluster autoscaling. 
This role combines software development with hands-on experience operating distributed cloud services. Your contributions will reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and help the platform grow safely. 
We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. 

Responsibilities
​​Develop and maintain software for cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle management. 
Build automation and self-service tooling that simplify recurring operational workflows and reduce manual intervention. 
Improve deployment pipelines, automated tests, release validation, diagnostics, and developer workflows. 
Use telemetry and debugging tools to investigate failures, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements. 
Contribute to fleet health, capacity management, free-pool optimization, and cluster autoscaling. 
Support new region and cloud deployments and help validate new compute, storage, and Service Fabric capabilities. 
Collaborate with experienced engineers and partner teams to design, test, deploy, and support scoped features. 
Document solutions, participate in code reviews, and apply secure and reliable engineering practices. 
Embody Microsoft's culture and values.​ 

Embody our culture and values

title: Senior Web Engineer (AI Fluent), Front End Products
description:
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Experian Partner Solutions (EPS) is looking for Senior Web Engineers to build the products our partners white label as their own – embedded components that run inside partner applications, and turnkey hosted sites that carry a partner's brand. When a partner puts our software in front of their customers, our code runs under their brand, in their environment, with their reputation attached. There is no margin for "it works on my machine."
We are looking for problem solvers first. We care much more about the depth and judgment you bring than about which specific frameworks you have used. Our stack is predominantly JavaScript and TypeScript across the browser and the server – React on the front end, Node in our services and tooling.
We are building this team around AI-assisted development. That is not a perk in the job description – it is the operating model. You will spend a significant share of your time directing AI coding agents, reviewing what those agents produce, and being personally accountable for code you did not type character by character. If that sounds like a downgrade of the craft, this is the wrong role. If it sounds like the most leveraged version of the job you have ever had, keep reading.
This is a senior individual contributor role. We are looking for someone with the architecture judgment to decide what to build, not just the speed to build it.
- Own web software end-to-end – design, build, ship, and support it in production. Ownership does not stop at the merge.
- Direct AI coding agents as your primary implementation method rather than hand-writing every line.
- Decompose features into work an agent can execute reliably, and write the prompts and specs that make that possible.
- Make the architecture calls AI cannot make for you: interface and API design, state and service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility for consumers who depend on your releases.
- Design for environments you do not control, whether that is a hostile host page, an unfamiliar partner configuration, or an unexpected client of your API.
- Use AI to generate test suites and regression coverage, then hunt what the generator missed: adversarial inputs, integration conflicts, and configuration edge cases.
- Assess blast radius before you merge — in a multi-tenant product, a change that is wrong for one partner is often wrong for all of them. 
Agentic Responsibilities:
- Fluent use of AI coding assistants – Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, or equivalent – as a primary development tool.
- Ability to decompose a non-trivial feature into chunks an agent completes reliably.
- A track record of catching real bugs, security issues, and bad architectural choices in AI-generated code.
- Ability to explain what makes a prompt produce usable code rather than plausible-looking garbage.
- Use of AI to generate tests, paired with a clear view of where those tests give false confidence.
- Architecture and system-design judgment that weighs at least as heavily as tooling fluency.
- Calibrated skepticism – you can name specific things AI is bad at in your domain.

- 6+ years building and shipping production web software, with real ownership of what you built after it went live.
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
- Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, applied across the browser and the server. We work primarily in React and Node; deep expertise in a comparable ecosystem plus evidence you pick up new stacks quickly is equally welcome.
- Component libraries, design systems, or SDKs consumed by teams outside your own — where breaking changes carry real cost.
- Server-side or full-stack web work — Node services, APIs, and the integrations that connect a customer-facing product to the systems behind it.
- Practical web security awareness: injection and XSS vectors, authentication and session handling, dependency risk, and safe handling of sensitive data.
- Experience with DevOps and CI/CD, automated test and build tooling.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
Benefits and Perks:
- Inclusive paid leave
- People-first and inclusive workplace
- Medical insurance

Senior Backend Engineer

As a Senior Backend Engineer on our Cloud Cost and Capacity capability, you'll build the internal software that helps us understand, attribute, and plan the cloud infrastructure that runs GitLab.com. You'll turn Google Cloud billing and usage data into pipelines, attribution models, and applications that help service owners understand what they consume and spend, plan reservations, and prevent capacity shortages.

You'll be the first engineer dedicated to this capability, setting the technical direction and building the foundations a growing team will extend. You'll treat cloud cost and capacity as one roadmap, choosing the architecture, data models, and tools that let service owners manage their usage and spending.

What you'll do

- Build data pipelines that turn Google Cloud billing exports and Cloud Monitoring telemetry into a clean, queryable picture of fleet usage and utilization in BigQuery.

- Attribute shared cost and usage across Google Kubernetes Engine clusters to the teams and services that drive them, using foundations such as OpenCost and Google Kubernetes Engine cost allocation.

- Develop capacity and demand tooling that profiles infrastructure needs by machine family and region to support reservation planning and prevent capacity shortages.

- Ship internal applications that let engineers and budget owners see and act on their cloud footprint, replacing manual snapshots and spreadsheets with software.

- Establish the data models, services, and engineering standards that future team members will extend, and help shape technical direction and hiring as we grow.

- Partner with Finance, product teams, service owners, and infrastructure engineers to turn their needs into technical designs.

- Use artificial intelligence in your daily engineering workflow to improve efficiency and outcomes, as we expect of all GitLab team members.

What you'll bring

- A track record of designing and shipping production backend services that you've owned end to end, beyond operating existing systems.

- Strong structured query language (SQL) skills with large datasets, experience building and maintaining data pipelines and models, and comfort working with cloud billing and usage data.

- Working knowledge of a major cloud platform, preferably Google Cloud, including compute services, Kubernetes, and pricing and billing models.

- Proficiency in a general-purpose programming language for tooling and pipelines. We value your ability to build and ship over mastery of a single language; Go and Python suit this work, and we use Ruby across our product code.

- The ability to break a new problem into milestones and drive it to production with light direction, communicating clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment.

We're part of the Cloud Cost Utilization team within Infrastructure Platforms, working with Fleet Management. title: Lead Full Stack Engineer, EDT Innovation Lab
description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

Lead Full Stack Engineer, EDT Innovation Lab 

The ED&T Innovation Lab is Stryker’s one front door for internal, non-commercial problems across our five business units and central functions. We run focused prototype sprints on real problems with real users and approved data, show progress in weekly demos and decide on evidence: stop, refine or scale. A fast, well-reasoned no is a successful outcome. What scales moves to a named delivery owner with a full handoff package; the Lab never keeps a product long term, and never bypasses Enterprise Architecture, security, compliance or QMS governance. Our promise: “Bring us the problem. We’ll test the possibility. Together we scale what works.” 
We are hiring Lead Full Stack Engineers in India as founding engineers of the Lab’s build team. This is a builder’s role with a scout’s curiosity: you will take ideas from a blank repo to a working demo in days or weeks, and spend real time researching, testing and experimenting with emerging technology so the Lab always knows what is possible next. You will report to the Senior Director, ED&T Innovation Lab, and work in a small, hands-on team across the US and India. 

What you will do:
- Own full-stack prototypes from first commit to working demo in 2–8-week sprints, spanning front end, APIs, services, data, cloud deployment and AI.
- Bring ideas to life through minimally functional prototypes tested by real users on real business problems with approved data, showcasing progress in weekly demos.
- Build AI-powered solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, tool calling, copilots, automation, and intelligent document and email processing.
- Explore emerging technologies—
- from AI and agents to automation, digital twins and quantum—and run time-boxed experiments, proofs of concept and technology comparisons to separate capability from hype.
- Shape technical direction for your prototypes: define architecture, break down delivery, assess existing Stryker capabilities for reuse and make evidence-based build-or-kill decisions, recognising a well-reasoned no as a successful outcome.
- Accelerate the Lab’s engineering foundations with reusable starter kits, components, templates, CI/CD pipelines and sandbox patterns, while maintaining clean code, targeted testing, secure defaults and practical documentation.
- Stay hands-on while reviewing code, pairing with and mentoring engineers, and partnering with the Lab leader to shape technical direction.
- Partner with business stakeholders and Business Innovation Partners to translate problems into buildable scope, clear hypotheses and measurable success criteria.
- Turn experimentation into shared insight through concise write-ups, demos, contributions to the Lab’s quarterly innovation radar for ED&T leadership and your own experiment ideas; capture what worked, what did not, and the cost and effort to scale.
- Equip delivery teams to scale validated prototypes with a complete handoff covering architecture, data, security context and next steps, working within Enterprise Architecture, cybersecurity, data privacy and QMS guardrails from day one.

What you need 
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with 5–8 years of professional software engineering experience in delivering full-stack web applications end to end. A relevant master’s degree is a plus.
- Must have Strong expertise in Python, TypeScript/React, Azure and hands-on LLM work, RESTful APIs, and SQL and NoSQL data modelling.
- Hands-on cloud-native development and deployment experience, preferably with Microsoft Azure App Service, Functions, containers, storage and identity. Azure certifications and enterprise integration experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph, SAP, Power Platform and Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on are advantages.
- Practical experience building LLM-powered applications, including RAG, agents or copilots, using Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs or similar technologies. Experience with Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph and Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus.
- A proven ability to turn concepts into working demos in days or weeks. Experience in an innovation lab, R&D group, startup, rapid product team or software-product company, alongside sustained impact and multi-year ownership across roles, will help you stand out.
- Solid engineering foundations in Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Docker and secure coding, with effective daily use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and sound judgement on code review and quality.
- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners and deliver confident demos. Ability to collaborate with a US-based team, including regular US Eastern Time overlap for demos, stand-ups and partner sessions.
- Preferred strengths include curiosity demonstrated through open-source contributions, side projects, hackathon wins, technical writing or talks; exposure to computer vision, speech, IoT and edge, digital twins, AR/VR or quantum computing; and experience in healthcare, medical devices or other regulated industries

Travel Percentage: None

Job Description

The Opportunity
- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
- 
- Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
- Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.
 
Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
 
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
 
Role Overview

We are seeking a Software Engineer with expertise in full-stack development, cloud technologies, and AI-driven engineering practices to build scalable enterprise solutions. 
The role focuses on developing, deploying, and supporting AI products and platforms using modern technologies, DevSecOps, and automated delivery pipelines. The individual will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation, deliver high-quality software, and transition new concepts from pilot stages to production.

- Deploy solutions on the cloud with CI/CD integration. 
- Deliver enterprise AI projects, products, and platforms with a focus on scalability and reusability. 
- Work on technical pilots and feasibility studies of new opportunities to create value and transitioning successful pilots to scalable production implementations. 
- Develop integrations with other applications and services. 
- Develop automated testing pipelines.
- Application release and second level support.
- Stay up to date with the latest advancements in software engineering technologies. 
- Participate in Agile ceremonies with the team to execute on prioritized projects and features.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Backend ( PNR )
description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY
Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Senior Software Development Engineer – Backend (PNR API Platform)

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY
Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform. Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Personalization & Recommendations (PNR) API Platform team, you will build and operate the backend systems that power personalized content discovery and recommendation experiences across FOX's digital products. The PNR API platform serves real-time personalized recommendations at scale, combining user behavioral signals, content metadata, vector similarity search, and ML model inference to deliver individualized experiences to millions of users.
You will work at the intersection of backend engineering and ML infrastructure - building recommendation engines, reranking services, user profile systems, and model serving pipelines. This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend microservices for real-time personalization and content recommendations
- Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from system design to production rollout and ongoing operations
- Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production
- Work with multiple data stores including relational databases, vector databases, search engines, key-value stores, and caching systems to build efficient data access patterns
- Integrate ML models into real-time serving pipelines, working closely with ML Engineers and Data Scientists
- Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions
- Optimize systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost at scale
- Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams to deliver recommendation capabilities across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV
- Participate in on-call rotation and drive production reliability and operational excellence
- Contribute to engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and security

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
- 5+ years of experience building backend software systems in production environments
- Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Golang
- Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability
- Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/Aurora) including query optimization and data modeling
- Experience with caching systems (Redis/ElastiCache) and cache invalidation strategies
- Experience working with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB) and understanding of access patterns and cost trade-offs
- Hands-on experience with cloud-based systems on AWS
- Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems
- Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with vector databases (Milvus, Zilliz, Pinecone) and similarity search systems
- Experience with search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch)
- Experience with ML model serving and real-time inference systems (Triton, KServe, SageMaker)
- Experience building recommendation engines, personalization platforms, or content ranking services
- Experience with event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS, Kafka)
- Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, pod tuning, HPA)
- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
- Observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
- Service mesh experience (Istio)
- Experience with experimentation / A/B testing platforms
- Experience with streaming platforms, digital media, or consumer-facing applications

description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
We are the ServiceNow Engineering team at Nike, and we provide cutting-edge service management solutions that enable Nike businesses to run their operations efficiently. We use ServiceNow as our Enterprise Service Management platform. ServiceNow enables our departments to digitize and automate business processes. We use it for its intuitive, omni-channel user experience with service portals, mobile interface and apps, and chat. We use its AI/ML capabilities with Virtual Agent for automated and prompt user interaction. We make use of its rich analytics features with trends and breakdowns. We also recognize that an effective and efficient digital ecosystem is made up of best-in-breed applications and we make use of ServiceNow APIs that enable workflows across platforms. We also incorporate GenAI solutions with ServiceNow to enhance efficiency for business.
ServiceNow is used at Nike for varied use cases - our Retail Store Athletes use the ServiceNow mobile app to request support on PoS systems promptly; our HR team uses ServiceNow as a medium for employees to seek HR cases support; our Technology Operations teams uses ServiceNow to manage incidents, fulfil requests using a service catalog, manage changes and host user facing knowledge articles as well as technical knowledge articles. We also use Performance Analytics to track Key Performance Indicators; our Procurement team uses it to manage purchase requests; our Risk & Compliance team uses it to manage risks; our Retail Partners team has setup a portal using ServiceNow for retail partners to seek technical support - the list goes on.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for graduates with around 6 years of development experience with the ServiceNow platform. Ideal candidate will have strong programming skills with exposure to automation frameworks, API-driven development and familiarity with GenAI and Agentic frameworks and good interpersonal skills to collaborate with peers, product managers and business stakeholders.
This role does configuration, development, administration and operational support tasks for all aspects of the ServiceNow platform including standard configuration, security, data management, reporting, integrations with third party applications and environment management while ensuring that data integrity, platform health and best practices are maintained.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
You’ll be working on designing, developing and running enterprise automation solutions, including but not limited to building workflows, self-service capabilities, and incident deflection systems, to enhance operational efficiency across the enterprise. You will work with a global team of engineers to unlock the potential of data. This will involve collaborating with cross-domain teams of engineers and product managers to integrate systems through API-driven development.

If this is you, you’ll be working with product managers to deliver technical solutions via Agile methodology that solve business problems while supporting the long-term health of the ServiceNow platform.
You will develop solutions using ServiceNow functionalities: -
- Configure and develop business rules, client scripts, script includes, UI policies and workflow logic

- Design secure role-based access, configure data permissions

- Build and manage integrations with third-party applications utilizing Web Services, Integration Hub and MID servers

- Enhance & optimize core products such as ITSM, ITAM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, Finance, Procurement

- Build and customize ServiceNow portals, widgets, pages, and themes

- Configure and extend ServiceNow mobile apps

- Optimize Chat & Virtual Agent

- Design and implement analytics solutions, reporting & dashboards

- Participate in / lead Scrum cadences – backlog refinement, sprint planning, retrospectives, stand-ups

- Author solution design & impact analysis documents, and technical knowledge articles

- Design, build, and execute comprehensive automated test frameworks using ServiceNow ATF to validate business logic

- Manage platform health & maintain the platform integrity, security and performance

- Guide junior developers, review update sets, and enforce best practices for scripting and system performance

- Troubleshoot and remediate functionality related incidents

description:
Job Overview
The Applications Development Analyst position is responsible for participating in the development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of application systems and microservices in coordination with the broader engineering team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to technical design, programming, system analysis, and automated deployments in a fast-paced agile environment.
The ideal candidate is a versatile and adaptable engineer who thrives across evolving technical domains—spanning backend microservices, full-stack modules, data workflows, and AI integrations—with a strong appetite for continuous learning and problem-solving.
Key Responsibilities
- Microservices Development: Participate in the design, development, unit testing, and maintenance of Python-based microservices and RESTful APIs using modern frameworks (FastAPI / Flask).
- Coding & Implementation: Write clean, modular, and maintainable core Python code adhering to standard software engineering best practices, design patterns, and architectural guidelines.
- Database & Data Layer Design: Implement and maintain robust data persistence layers utilizing document and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB and Couchbase, ensuring efficient indexing, schema design, and query performance.
- Containerization & Deployment: Containerize services using Docker and assist in managing, configuring, and deploying workloads onto Kubernetes / OpenShift clusters.
- CI/CD Integration: Work with automated CI/CD pipelines and deployment tools (e.g., Helm, Harness) for automated building, linting, testing, and continuous deployment.
- Full-Stack & GenAI Integration: Build and integrate frontend interfaces with Angular where required, and assist in connecting LLM / Generative AI capabilities into backend workflows.
- Semantic & Data Modeling: Assist in building and integrating semantic models, embeddings, metadata definitions, and structured schemas to support intelligent data retrieval, semantic search, and domain data layers.
- Cross-Functional Flexibility: Demonstrate agility by adapting to varying technical demands across backend, UI, data engineering, and emerging AI technologies as project needs evolve.
- Agile Participation: Actively engage in daily standups, sprint planning, task estimation, code reviews, and retrospectives within an Agile/Scrum team.
- Issue Resolution & Support: Assist in troubleshooting system defects, investigating application errors, analyzing logs, and supporting production releases.
- Risk & Control: Appropriately assess risk when technical decisions are made, adhering to company security standards, coding guidelines, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Required Qualifications & Technical Skills
1. Core Technical Experience
- Core Python Proficiency: Strong foundation in Python, data structures, OOP concepts, functional paradigms, error handling, and asynchronous programming (asyncio).
- Microservices Architecture & APIs: Practical experience in designing and developing decoupled, resilient microservices and RESTful APIs using FastAPI or Flask, including inter-service communication, error handling, and API versioning.
- NoSQL Databases (MongoDB & Couchbase): Solid hands-on experience working with document/NoSQL stores such as MongoDB and Couchbase, including document modeling, query optimization, indexing strategies, and connection lifecycle management.

How We Build

- Align fast on what matters.
- Divide and conquer. Own your piece.
- Ship. Watch customers use it.
- Learn and repeat.

Why Join Cloudflare in India?

Impact at global scale: Your code will serve Cloudflare's customers across every region. Tens of millions of Internet properties depend on us.

Work on the edge: Few companies give engineers the chance to build AI directly into an edge platform that runs in 300+ cities worldwide.

Career growth: As one of the early engineers in our India based AI team, you'll have visibility, leadership opportunities, and a direct hand in shaping Cloudflare's AI roadmap.

Culture of ownership: We believe in autonomy, accountability, and trust. Engineers here own outcomes, not just tickets.

Learn and grow fast: Collaborate with peers across Support, Product, Security, and AI Platform teams. We encourage knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

- Build a mini agent on Workers using the Agent SDK
- Store session memory in Durable Objects
- Add semantic recall with Vectorize
- Ship behind a KV flag with traces and observability
- Push to production fast and take ownership

The Agent Tech team owns the end to end stack for customer facing agents on Cloudflare. Everything runs at the edge.

Core Stack: Workers, Durable Objects, KV, R2, D1, Queues, Pub/Sub, Vectorize, Workers AI, AI Gateway, Pages, Zero Trust.

Principles: Ship fast. Measure truth. Simplify relentlessly. Own outcomes.

Fraud Alert: Do not fall victim to recruitment fraud. Cloudflare never charges application fees or requires candidates to purchase third-party certifications or training as a condition of employment. All official communication comes strictly from @cloudflare.com email addresses.

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

description:
Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to build the future of connected work, from ideas to impact.

As the global leader in work and resource management, Planview helps organizations accelerate the achievement of what matters most, supporting our customers from need to speed, from passion to progress, and from overhead to optimization. We provide the industry’s most comprehensive solutions designed for strategic planning, portfolio and resource management, Lean and Agile delivery, product portfolio management, capability, and technology management (enterprise architecture), innovation management, and collaborative work and project management. Our connected platform of solutions underpins the business and digital transformations of more than 4,500 customers globally, including 59 of the Fortune 100.

At Planview, our people connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1400+ work remotely and across our offices including Austin, Vancouver, Hod Hasharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We’re proud of our world-class, connected culture built on our shared values, that supports our teams to be successful from anywhere.

Learn more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.

The Opportunity

About The Role

Join Planview's Product Development team as a Senior Software Engineer I on the OKRs team. You will design, build, and evolve web applications using Python on the backend and React on the frontend, with a primary focus on backend (roughly 70% backend / 30% frontend).

You will own features from concept through deployment, contribute to technical strategy, and help build secure, scalable, and maintainable products. Working closely with Product, Design, and QA, you will also raise engineering quality through thoughtful code reviews, strong development practices, and mentorship.

What You'll Do

- Design and develop modern web applications using Python and React.
- Build RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs using Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
- Lead technical design discussions, create architecture documents, and drive decisions on scalability, security, performance, and maintainability.
- Own features end to end, from discovery and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
- Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality customer outcomes.
- Conduct code reviews, promote engineering best practices, and mentor mid-level and junior engineers.
- Optimize performance across the stack, including frontend rendering, API latency, and database queries.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and contribute to cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and observability.
- Identify and reduce technical debt, including leading modernization, refactoring, and migration initiatives.
- Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, and lead root-cause analysis for production issues

What You'll Bring

- 9–11 years of experience building and maintaining production-grade web applications, with strong expertise in Python (backend) and hands-on experience with React (frontend).
- Strong proficiency in Python and experience with Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
- Solid understanding of async programming, background job processing (e.g., Celery, RQ), API design, database design, and scalable backend architecture.
- Strong system design skills: ability to design scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems, make sound technical trade-offs, and translate business requirements into robust designs.
- Experience with React, including Hooks, Context, and state/data management using Redux, Zustand, or React Query.
- Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Strong database fundamentals, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL; experience with NoSQL technologies such as MongoDB and Redis.
- Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Git workflows, and automated testing (Jest and React Testing Library on the frontend, PyTest on the backend).
- Practical knowledge of application security, including OAuth, JWT, and OWASP principles.
- Strong debugging, performance optimization, and code quality skills, with the ability to independently own technical problems.
- Clear communication skills, with the ability to influence design decisions and work effectively across teams.

Nice to Have

- Experience with AWS.
- Experience with Next.js, server-side rendering, or micro-frontend architectures.
- Exposure to message queues and event streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS).
- Knowledge of GraphQL.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
- Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, ELK).
- Knowledge of AI/ML integration or Python data pipelines.
- Experience in SaaS, fintech, or enterprise product environments.
- Open-source contributions, technical blog posts, or conference talks.

Benefits At Planview

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

- Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
- Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
- Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
- Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
- Employee Referral bonus program.
- Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
- Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

AI Use in Recruitment

Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. If you require further information or would like to exercise your rights under applicable privacy laws, please submit your request at the Planview Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) Portal.

title: Software Engineer III – Data Platform and Analytics
description:
Summary

Our Product Development & Operations (PDO) organization builds and runs the cloud platform that powers how P&C insurers around the world do business, with a strong focus on AI, cloud, and data platform adoption. You will join the Data Platform and Analytics team, which delivers secure, scalable data services that enable mission-critical insights for our customers. We work in an inclusive, collaborative environment using modern cloud-native technologies to solve complex data and distributed systems problems.

As a Software Engineer III, you will design and build cloud-native data and analytics services that sit at the heart of Guidewire’s platform strategy. You will use your expertise in modern Java, microservices, and frontend technologies like React or Angular to create large-scale, real-time data and analytics capabilities in the public cloud. This role is a key contributor to PDO’s priorities around operational excellence and transformative innovation, directly advancing Guidewire’s mission to combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business.

Job Description

What you’ll do

- Design, develop, and operate cloud-native data platform and analytics SaaS services that are secure, scalable, and reliable, supporting PDO’s focus on operational excellence and data platform adoption. 
- Build and maintain large-scale, real-time stream processing and data ingestion systems that power analytics, data science, and reporting for our customers.
- Design, implement, and run microservices-based solutions using modern Java and frameworks such as Spring Boot, applying microservices and domain-driven design patterns.
- Contribute to intuitive, performant user experiences using modern frontend technologies (React.js or Angular, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) for data and analytics workflows.
- Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for your services, leveraging containers and Kubernetes to ensure fast, safe, and repeatable releases.
- Take responsibility for availability, performance, observability, and data security of your services, including triaging and resolving production issues and defects.
- Maintain secure coding practices, address application security findings, and collaborate with Security and platform teams to support strong governance and compliance goals. 
- At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

Required

What you would need to succeed:

- Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
- 6+ years of relevant software engineering experience building production-grade services or applications.
- Experience designing and developing backend services in Java, ideally with Spring Boot, and familiarity with microservices and multithreading concepts.
- Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and performance optimization techniques, especially in distributed or data-intensive systems.
- Strong programming skills in JavaScript and at least one modern frontend framework such as React.js or Angular, with solid knowledge of HTML and CSS.
- Working knowledge of relational databases (such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar) and experience with data warehousing technologies such as Amazon Redshift or equivalent.
- Familiarity with microservices architecture patterns such as service discovery, API gateways, and domain-driven design.
- Ability to thrive in an agile, fast-paced environment, collaborating across functions and locations in a transparent, inclusive way.
- Clear, respectful communication skills and a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new tools, domains, and ways of working.

Preferred

- Hands-on experience with AWS or another major public cloud provider (e.g., IAM, networking, managed databases, streaming services).
- Experience building and operating containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes; familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
- Exposure to building large-scale real-time data streaming or event-driven systems (e.g., Apache Kafka, Kinesis, or similar).
- Experience with observability and logging stacks such as ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) or equivalent tools.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as TeamCity or similar systems.
- Understanding of distributed systems principles (consistency, availability, durability, reliability, fault tolerance, consensus algorithms) and how to apply them in production systems.
- Experience with AWS RDS or other managed relational database services.

Your Impact

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take ownership of one or more data platform or analytics services, deep dive into our architecture and tooling, and deliver features that enhance real-time data processing, scalability, and user experience. You will help improve service reliability, harden security, and evolve CI/CD pipelines, directly contributing to PDO’s goals around secure, efficient, and AI-ready cloud operations and data platforms.

As your expertise grows, your work will influence how insurers unlock insights from Guidewire Data Platform and analytics products, shaping customer outcomes and contributing to Guidewire’s broader mission to transform P&C insurance with cloud, analytics, and AI.

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

title: Senior Engineer, Full-Stack Development
description:
Full-Stack Web Developer

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You Are

You are an early-career developer who has moved past tutorials and built things that actually run in production or close to it. You know the difference between code that works on your laptop and code that someone else can deploy, maintain, and extend six months later. When something breaks, you dig in. When requirements are unclear, you ask the right questions instead of guessing or waiting.

You have written enough JavaScript and TypeScript to know when a component is getting too complicated, and you care about that. Working across front-end, back-end, and database layers does not intimidate you because you have done it before, even if not at scale. You learn by building, not by collecting certifications.

Small teams appeal to you because your work is visible and your contributions matter from day one. You want to be in a place where asking good questions is valued, where senior engineers actually review your code and explain the why, and where you can see the impact of what you ship. At Synopsys, you will work on internal platforms that employees across the company depend on, and the team you join operates like a high-trust startup inside a global organization.

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and maintain full-stack web applications using the PANN stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js
- Implement features across the entire application layer, from UI components in Angular to API endpoints in NestJS to database schema changes in PostgreSQL
- Work with Prisma ORM to model data, manage migrations, and write clean database access logic
- Collaborate with cybersecurity, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into working software that solves real problems
- Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and orchestrate services in environments managed with Kubernetes, Nginx, and Apache
- Contribute to AI-enabled features including retrieval-augmented generation workflows, prompt engineering, and automation that pulls from internal knowledge repositories
- Support CI/CD pipelines and help maintain production systems through monitoring, debugging, and performance tuning

The Impact You Will Have

- Your code will power internal platforms used daily by employees across Synopsys to get work done faster and more securely
- You will reduce manual effort and operational overhead by automating repetitive workflows and integrating disconnected systems
- The features you build will improve how teams access organizational knowledge, make decisions, and collaborate across functions
- Your contributions will help scale cybersecurity, compliance, and engineering operations across a 30,000-person global organization
- You will enable better data-driven decision-making by building intuitive interfaces that surface the right information at the right time
- Working in a small, high-impact team means your individual work will be visible and valued, not lost in a backlog
- You will help lay the foundation for scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple business units as the platform grows

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent hands-on experience building and shipping web applications
- 2 to 4 years of experience developing full-stack web applications, though stronger evidence of end-to-end delivery can matter more than years
- Hands-on experience with the PANN technology stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js in real projects, not just side experiments
- Solid working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and REST API design
- Experience using Prisma or a comparable ORM for data modeling, schema migrations, and database access patterns
- Familiarity with Docker for containerization and exposure to Kubernetes, Nginx, or Apache in deployment contexts
- Practical exposure to AI technologies such as large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or automation workflows, whether through work, coursework, or personal projects
- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and secure coding principles
- Experience integrating systems through APIs and working with both relational and non-relational databases
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, you can explain what you built, why you built it that way, and what tradeoffs you made

Who You Are

- You take ownership of your work and follow through, even when it means asking for help or clarification along the way
- When you encounter a problem you do not immediately know how to solve, you research, test, and ask targeted questions instead of spinning or guessing
- You write code with the next person in mind, whether that is a teammate doing a review or your future self debugging at 3pm on a Tuesday
- You are comfortable working in a small team where accountability is high and your contributions are visible from day one
- Curiosity drives you, especially around emerging technologies like AI, and you are eager to apply them to solve real business problems, not just experiment
- You can collaborate effectively with people outside engineering, translating technical constraints into language that product and business stakeholders actually understand
- You care about user experience and think through how the features you build will actually be used, not just whether they technically function
- Results matter to you more than process for its own sake, you want to ship things that work and make a measurable difference

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your team develops platforms and capabilities that help scale cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and business operations across Synopsys. The team operates with a startup mindset, focusing on high-impact initiatives, rapid execution, and practical innovation. You will work closely with a small group of technical and domain experts to build solutions that enable automation, knowledge management, and data-driven decision making. Individual contributions are highly visible, and you will have direct access to senior engineers who will review your work, explain tradeoffs, and help you grow.

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Software Engineer II, Reinforcement Learning Environments
description:
About Handshake

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why Join Handshake Now

- Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
- Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
- Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
- Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

We are building our India team to help accelerate the development of frontier models. This team is a critical, strategic investment for us - we have grown the team 3x in the past six months to help fuel our next phase of growth. India-based teammates will work hand-in-hand with US-based teams to scope, execute, and deliver critical human data projects to Frontier Labs and other customers.

About The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer II to help build our Reinforcement Learning Environments (RLE) platform—the interactive systems where frontier AI models learn to complete real-world work.

RLE environments simulate end-to-end workflows across domains like software engineering, finance, legal research, and business operations with realistic tools, constraints, and feedback loops. The interaction data generated powers the training and evaluation of the world's leading AI models.

As part of our growing engineering organization in India, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US to build the platforms powering the next generation of AI. You'll own meaningful technical projects, contribute to platform architecture, and help build reliable systems that enable researchers to rapidly develop and evaluate frontier AI models.

What Success Looks Like

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer
This role aligns with market job titles such as Agentic system engineer, Agentic Ai Engineer, or AgentOps Engineer
Drive the future of Agentic AI at Pearson as part of the AgentOps Engineering team. Inspire innovation. Empower learning.
Pearson, the world’s leading learning company, is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to play a key role on our AgentOps Engineering team.
Why This Role Matters
Are you passionate about building AI agents that reason, plan, route work, and run reliably in production—not just prototypes? Do you want to shape how an enterprise builds, operates, and governs digital workers at scale? Join our AgentOps Engineering team and help build the core platform capabilities that power agent crews running across the business.
This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on building. You’ll ship the write-path features that let agents take real actions, design the orchestration and routing patterns that direct work to the right agent, and engineer enhancements to the platform itself—working inside it, not just on top of it. Through this, you’ll help teams across Pearson put dependable AI agents to work, and help people realize the lives they imagine through learning.
As a key member of the AgentOps Engineering team and Pearson, you will be expected to embody, and role model our leadership dimensions:
- Live Our Purpose: You connect your engineering work to Pearson’s mission and make decisions that reflect a clear understanding of our strategy.
- Simplify the Complexity: You navigate ambiguity in a fast-changing field and distil complex agentic systems into clear, reliable solutions.
- Carry Our Culture: You collaborate generously, mentor through design and code reviews, and contribute to an inclusive, high-performing team.
- Deliver Results: You set a high quality bar, get the details right, and own outcomes that matter to learners and stakeholders.
What You’ll Do
- Build write-path features
- Ship the features that let agents take real, governed actions—wrapping enterprise APIs, validators, and data sources so agents can write, not just read.
- Design safe write semantics: idempotency, confirmation and human-in-the-loop gates, structured outputs, and audit-ready action logging.
- Design multi-agent orchestration
- Build multi-agent and digital-worker orchestration patterns that let specialized agents delegate, collaborate, and complete multi-step goals.
- Build stateful, cyclic workflows using modern agent orchestration frameworks—enabling reflection, recovery, and adaptive execution beyond linear chains.
- Engineer agent routing
- Build the routing layer that directs requests to the right agent or crew—intent classification, capability-based dispatch, fallback, and escalation paths.
- Create reusable components for retries, degraded modes, and human handoff; tune agent roles, goals, and prompts using fixtures and golden sets.
- Enhance the platform
- Work hands-on with the agentic platform—creating, versioning, invoking, and debugging crews, tasks, and graphs through platform APIs—and contribute enhancements back where new patterns are needed.
- Design long-running, resumable workflows (checkpointing, persistence, context restoration) and resilience patterns for non-deterministic AI.
- Ship with AI, at quality
- Work primarily through AI-pair-programming as your default mode—researching, scaffolding, implementing, reviewing, and shipping at high velocity while holding quality through TDD and rigorous verification.
- Raise the bar
- Drive reusable engineering standards, shared libraries, and reference patterns; mentor engineers through design and code reviews; and share the prompts, skills, and workflows that multiply everyone’s output.
Who You Are
- A hands-on senior engineer who builds production-grade agentic systems, not demos.
- An independent owner who takes complex workstreams from ambiguity to reliable, shipped software.
- A collaborator who influences through standards and mentoring, without needing authority.
- Someone with strong taste and trade-off judgment across quality, latency, cost, resilience, and maintainability.
What You’ll Bring
(we hire for demonstrated skill, not years on a résumé)
- You build LLM-powered systems, agents, or digital workers that run in production.
- Strong Python and backend/platform engineering—async services, typed code, and clean architecture.
- You work fluently with agent orchestration frameworks and can design, build, and orchestrate reliable agent tools—contracts, error handling, tool chaining.
- You’ve built routing, dispatch, or workflow-control logic that directs work across components or services.
- You use AI-pair-programming as a primary delivery mode without sacrificing quality.
- Strong prompt engineering for structured outputs, nested schemas, and multi-agent coordination.
- You read, edit, and contribute to a real platform codebase—APIs, runtime, storage—not just an SDK.
- Solid APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering, with production-reliability instincts.
Even Better…
- Experience evaluating agents—task success, groundedness, tool-use accuracy, schema conformance, and regression against golden fixtures.
- Experience with tool/context interoperability protocols (such as MCP).
- Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), containerization, and CI/CD; familiarity with state stores for orchestration and persistence.
- AI observability and evaluation tooling for LLM systems.
- RAG and memory patterns: vector databases, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, and grounding.
- Secure execution, sandboxing, and prompt-injection mitigation.
What You’ll Gain
- A front-row seat building enterprise agentic AI infrastructure that teams across Pearson rely on.
- Real ownership of orchestration, routing, and platform patterns others adopt.
- A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven culture.
- Access to cutting-edge tools, platforms, and thought leadership.
Why Pearson?
At Pearson, we don’t just build careers—we accelerate them. Known for our strong culture of internal mobility and leadership development, we offer a clear path to broader technical and leadership roles.
We believe great work deserves great rewards. That’s why we offer some of the most competitive benefits in the industry—designed to support the diverse needs of our people and their families. Explore our Benefits.
At Pearson, we’re reimagining learning through technology. If you’re an engineer who thrives in complexity, builds with craft, and is excited to put AI agents to work at scale—we’d love to hear from you.
